regression_test.contract: A gateway that reaches serving (start_gateway() past runner.start(), cron and housekeeping started) runs the real [MEMORY] monitor thread at logging.memory_monitor.interval_seconds (default 300), does not start it when enabled: false, and has stopped it by the time start_gateway() returns, whether the exit is clean, a failure verdict or an aborted startup.

It starts only after the aborted-startup guard and stops in a finally around wait_for_shutdown(). Its 2026-07-15 force-push answers teknium1's sweeper review, and its own tests pass on main after the rebase. It is not the earliest: #49782 fails the config contract, which teknium1's sweeper review asked it to restore. #49789 (the earliest config-aware PR) silently disables monitoring on a malformed interval, passes 0/negative through (verified about 100k [MEMORY] lines/s), and 4 of its 7 tests fail on main. #50472's run.py change re-indents a tail that main has since refactored, so porting it means re-implementing it, and it also passes 0/negative through. The rebase is mechanical except for one token, _load_gateway_runtime_config() -> _load_gateway_config(). Without it, start_gateway() raises NameError.
